title: WebCrawler accepted findings
description: The file named by --accepted: findings you looked at and decided to live with. They are listed apart and never reported as new.

code.description: finding code or glob, e.g. no-csp or cookie-*

where.description: URL, host or glob the entry covers, e.g. https://example.com/docs/*

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD; after this day the finding counts again
